Accomplishment
1. President of TAA /Pittsburgh Chapter (匹茲堡台灣同鄉會會長) 1979

2. Secretary of Taiwan Literature Research Association (台灣文學研究會秘書) 1986-1988

3. Editor of Column of Taiwan Tribune (台灣公論報文化專刊及文學園二版主編) 1998-2002

4. Published 14 Taiwanese books and many articles in T. A. newspapers, newsletters, and magazines.

5. Outstanding Taiwanese American Elected by T.A. Archives in 09/2018
